name: wifi
title: Wi-Fi
description: The current network, the saved ones and what is in range: join, forget, copy the password, turn Wi-Fi off.
author: pal

store.tagline: Join, forget or inspect Wi-Fi networks; switch the radio
features: Current, Known and Available sections, with signal, channel, security and IP for the network you are on; `cmd+i` shows a network as a page
`enter` joins a network, asking for the password in the search bar when it needs one
`cmd+shift+c` copies a saved network's password (macOS asks for your keychain)
`ctrl+x` forgets a network after a confirm; `cmd+c` copies the name or IP
Turn Wi-Fi off or on, and scan for networks on macOS
On macOS network names need Location access; it asks once, only when you open the list

screenshots.caption: The current network with its address and signal, the saved ones, then what is in range
Joining a secured network that is not saved asks for its password
A saved network: join it, copy its name or its password, forget it
Forget asks first, since the saved password goes with it
The current network's detail (cmd+I): connected and its security as chips, signal and channel large, then its address
